capabilities: Open .mermaid and .mmd files as native diagram views
Toggle between preview, split, and source view modes
Pan and zoom diagrams with mouse wheel and drag
Export diagrams as SVG or PNG files
Embed mermaid files in notes via standard embed syntax
intentEvidence: Mermaid diagrams can be rendered in three ways within Obsidian. This plugin enhances all of them
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid inside markdown code blocks; standalone diagram files have no native view, editor, pan/zoom, or export support.
summary: Viewer and editor that opens .mermaid and .mmd files as first-class citizens with rendered diagrams, pan/zoom, and SVG/PNG export.
